mapper.insert: insert into user (name, phone, sex, id_number, avatar, follower_count, following_count, liked_count, post_count, create_time) values (#{name}, #{phone}, #{sex}, #{idNumber}, #{avatar}, 0, 0, 0, 0, #{createTime})
mapper.select: select count(1) from user where create_time >= #{begin} and create_time <= #{end}
